placement.note: Castle-local frame like a town GLB: origin = footprint centre at ground, +Z = front (gate). Town local pos/rotY as in placements.json. rotY = the live chapel yaw after xk() (-0.0698 clamped to -0.4898), so the gate faces the square.

stairs.ramp: two ak_stairs_timber_1w_3r pieces scaled (1.25,1.333,1.25); their col_stairs_ramp are walkable, not blockers

roof.type: flat battlemented deck at y=8 (roof_* nodes), hidden by the town cutaway when the player is inside

camera.parts: node names follow tagCamBuilding(): L0 walls = wall, L1 walls up_*, upper floor floor_upper_*, roof roof_*, stairs stairs_*, upper props/rails up_*

pieces.note: Re-used Chapel of St. Noll bell tower. door_tower_arch opens +x into the apothecary. Its col_tower_* go in BOTH level sets; ignore col_tower_floor_*/col_tower_ladder for level 1.
